name: jevgate
description: Jev-backed gates for Claude Code: bash guard for bypass mode, file guard, done-check, subagent gate, verbatim compaction. Each feature toggles independently.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment or settings env.

bashEnabled.title: Bash guard
bashEnabled.description: Deny harmful shell commands in bypassPermissions mode. Read-only commands from Claude Code's own free set run without asking Jev; everything else is judged once.

bashRecentMessages.title: Bash guard: recent messages
bashRecentMessages.description: How many of the latest user messages Jev sees when judging a command.

bashAllowMax.title: Bash guard: allow ceiling
bashAllowMax.description: When every deny category scores under this, the hook answers allow and auto mode skips its classifier. 0 disables the allow path (deny only).

bashDenyDestroy.title: Deny: destroys uncommitted work
bashDenyDestroy.description: Minimum Jev probability to deny: reset --hard, checkout --, clean, or rm on paths with uncommitted changes. 0 means log only.

bashDenyDeleteOutside.title: Deny: deletes outside repo
bashDenyDeleteOutside.description: Minimum Jev probability to deny: rm/mv targets outside the repository and scratchpad, or critical paths. 0 means log only.

bashDenyHistory.title: Deny: rewrites shared history
bashDenyHistory.description: Minimum Jev probability to deny: force push, push to protected branches, remote changes, filter-branch. 0 means log only.

bashDenyDeploy.title: Deny: deploys or publishes
bashDenyDeploy.description: Minimum Jev probability to deny: deploy, publish, release, merge, production targets. 0 means log only.

bashDenyExfil.title: Deny: exfiltrates
bashDenyExfil.description: Minimum Jev probability to deny: sends local data to a host that is not localhost or a known remote. 0 means log only.

bashDenySecrets.title: Deny: reads secrets
bashDenySecrets.description: Minimum Jev probability to deny: .env, ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, keychain, tokens. 0 means log only.

bashDenySystem.title: Deny: escalates or changes system
bashDenySystem.description: Minimum Jev probability to deny: sudo, launchctl, crontab, system config, unrelated processes, global installs. 0 means log only.

bashDenyExceeds.title: Deny: exceeds request
bashDenyExceeds.description: Minimum Jev probability to deny: does something the recent user messages did not ask for. 0 logs the score without denying.. 0 means log only.

fileEnabled.title: File guard
fileEnabled.description: Edit/Write/Read guard. Writes inside the project are free; a write outside it is judged by Jev; a read of a credential path is refused.

fileDenySystem.title: File guard: deny system or user config
fileDenySystem.description: Minimum Jev probability to deny a write outside the project that changes shell, git, ssh, Claude settings or system configuration. 0 means log only.

fileDenyExceeds.title: File guard: deny exceeds request
fileDenyExceeds.description: Minimum Jev probability to deny an outside write the recent user messages did not ask for. 0 logs the score without denying.

doneEnabled.title: Done-check
doneEnabled.description: Block Claude from stopping when the diff does not cover the request or the final message overclaims.

doneMaxBlocks.title: Done-check max blocks
doneMaxBlocks.description: Blocks per turn before letting Claude stop anyway.

agentEnabled.title: Subagent gate
agentEnabled.description: Deny a subagent spawn when the answer is already in the recent conversation.

agentThreshold.title: Subagent deny threshold
agentThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that the answer is already in context.

compactEnabled.title: Verbatim compaction
compactEnabled.description: Replace the compaction summary with the original messages, long tool outputs truncated. Requires CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.

compactUseJev.title: Compaction: rank with Jev
compactUseJev.description: Ask Jev which truncated outputs to restore verbatim. Off means deterministic truncation only.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction trigger percent
compactAtPercent.description: Context usage at which jevgate requests compaction itself.

compactPreserveRecent.title: Compaction: recent messages pinned
compactPreserveRecent.description: Newest messages never truncated. The first message and all Edit/Write results are always pinned.

compactTruncateHeadChars.title: Compaction: head chars kept
compactTruncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a truncated tool output kept before the note.

compactRestoreTopK.title: Compaction: outputs restored
compactRestoreTopK.description: How many of the highest-scoring truncated outputs Jev may restore verbatim.

compactMinReductionRatio.title: Compaction: minimum reduction
compactMinReductionRatio.description: Below this fraction saved, fall back to the built-in summary.
